03 / About

Hi, I'm Naman

Explorer & Builder

I'm a student and explorer who builds whatever sparks my curiosity. Not a professional full-stack developer — just someone who loves turning "what if" into working code.

My interests live at the intersection of AI,3D graphics, generative art, and creative tools. I gravitate toward projects that feel like toys but solve real problems — local-first AI assistants, browser-based 3D editors, physics playgrounds, autonomous agents that browse the web for you.

Everything I build is open source. I believe the best tools are transparent, hackable, and respect your data. No telemetry, no cloud lock-in, no dark patterns.

How I Work

  • 01

    Curiosity First

    Start with a question, not a roadmap. The best projects begin as experiments.

  • 02

    Local-First by Default

    Your data stays on your device. Cloud is optional, not required.

  • 03

    Ship the Toy

    Polish comes later. If it's fun and works, it's worth sharing.

  • 04

    Open Everything

    Source code, learnings, failures — all public. Community makes it better.
